digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI/MCP explain
propositions: Authors lack concise, dedicated on-ramp documentation for writing plans that pass the plan-review gate and code that passes the code-review gate; existing material is either gate-mechanics or reviewer-facing criterion registry.
The CLI/MCP explain seam must be extended to route author-guide names ('rebar explain plan', 'rebar explain review') through the shared registry lookup.
AGENTS.md currently mispoints authors at the criterion registry for the description template and lacks a code-review on-ramp reference.
Hand-written prose on-ramp docs must remain distinct from the generated criterion registry to preserve the registry as single source of truth.
New docs must be linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate; all three explain surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) must handle both guide names and criterion IDs.
